status: Prospective measurement clarifications; fixed policies and endpoints unchanged; written before C profiling/treatments
entropy_slack: 0.005 minus recomputed mean entropy of actual returned native scaled logits; actual native confidence flag is authoritative
caps: Report native48-call event and output-token cap separately; if both adaptive predicates and48-call cap occur, preserve both flags and identify cap coincidence
boundary_N_counter: Boundary sampler-exit hook runs before worker bookkeeping increments N; its raw event N is the pre-call ordinary-call count. Completed count for ordinary_sampler_exit and next_canvas_first_sampler_exit is rawN+1; model-entry/commit N uses rawN.
boundary_cache_phase: Model-entry snapshot stores input/state; per-layer attached cache and attention-output snapshots are after that native layer runs. Next-first cache includes its current stochastic tail. Compare own commits, never inactive allocation capacity.
signed_zero: Byte inequality is not numerical inequality. Canonicalization touches CPU copies only. Nonfinite counts are explicit; equal canonical-NaN hashes are not evidence of ordinary finite numerical equality.
acceptance: No exact compiled acceptance-count or proposal-reconstruction claim
reference_winners: Actual native winners; reference agreement is not task correctness. Signed fixed-reference-winner margin changes, adverse and favorable tails are retained.
matching: High/low matching pertains to the frozen varied unit and composite maximum metrics. CE comparisons may be unmatched. Aliases are not independent evidence.
timing: Use clean synchronized W/S/SN only with zero actual new captures/JIT and exact audit-clean output,N,C,T,RNG/forward/support checks. Never retime toward favorable results. Allocation includes all worker overhead and is not clean latency.
timing_primary_seed_pairs: For all-panel primary timing summaries require both paired seeds valid to include a question in a two-seed cluster interval; retain missing timing cells explicitly. Conditional exposed/common-eligible available-case summaries must disclose each seed/question denominator and cannot establish both-seed replication if one is missing.
question_clustering: Four question clusters/task, two seeds each; targeted and coverage two clusters each.20000bootstrap draws seed20261026; descriptive95percent intervals, no noninferiority claim.
quality: All complete requests scored officially. Preserve every correct-to-wrong and reverse transition against FULL,A,CE,sham. Wrong/capped or no-pulse pairs do not certify sparse quality preservation.
scope: Single pulse; no AA/SA/AS/SS interaction, hold/reuse, restoration certificate, production promotion or StageB/C inference
